name: io.github.Servosity/keeper-mcp
title: Keeper Security MCP
description: Read-only Keeper MSP posture across every client, with history, a change feed and no path to a

environmentVariables.name: KEEPER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Keeper Commander Service Mode API key service-create printed. It is sent only to your Service Mode host.

environmentVariables.name: KEEPER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Keeper Commander Service Mode host, e.g. https://keeper-svc.example.internal:9090 (https only; run Service Mode with TLS).

environmentVariables.name: KEEPER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to remove every MCP tool that writes this connector's local files. Keeper reads stay available.

environmentVariables.name: KEEPER_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to refuse posture report, the one command that saves Keeper data locally. Live reads still work.

environmentVariables.name: KEEPER_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: KEEPER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the client sends to your Service Mode host.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The name of a client profile to bind this MCP server to.
